lines.text: Hello? Hello! Is this thing on? Is anybody out there?
This is the farmers' hideout, out past the junctions. We saw your gateway light up the sky last night.
If you made it through the zone in one piece, you're the only one who has in a long while.
We're in a bad way. The storms keep closing in, the bots ransacked the fields, and the pantry's near empty.
There's no way out of here for us. Not with our old trucks, not through all that.
Please, come find us. We're down a side road, off one of the first junctions out from your garage.
Look for it on your Route Planner. We'll keep the lights on for you.
And hurry. Please.
Well I'll be. You actually came. Welcome to what's left of the hideout.
I won't lie to you, we're hungry. The fields out here grow nothing but weeds and bot scrap now.
But the old packing stations out on the roads still have food in them. Crates of it, if the bots haven't torn them apart.
Pack us some crates and bring them back here. Drop them in the dropzone out front and hit the button.
Do that, and I'll get you something worth the trouble: a key to the Mid Zone. We've been holding on to one for years.
Mind you, past those junctions it's dangerous. The ground's soaked in chemicals and the bots out there shoot back.
So stock up, keep your car in one piece, and get us that food. We'll be right here.
Any luck with those crates? The packing stations are out along the roads.
Bring them to the dropzone out front. That key to the Mid Zone is yours once we're fed.
Would you look at that. Real food, fresh from the packing stations. We'll finally eat well.
You've done more for us than anyone else out here ever has. We won't forget it.
A deal's a deal. Here: the key to the Mid Zone. It opens the way past the Outer Zone's last junctions.
Go on, take it. And remember what I said: it's a whole lot meaner out there.
We owe you one, friend. Watch yourself out there in the Mid Zone.
